row.title: Shallow clones made every recurring failure look seen today; skipped checks merged via legacy /status; schema errors now heal in-tick
row.body: Session: session_0156nqDte8FeqRLjvGRAAb6w. (1) SHALLOW-TIME-1: failmine dated issue events by git --diff-filter=A; in a shallow checkout the boundary commit adds every file, so every Q-RECUR signature read 'last seen' at the boundary and no probe could go quiet. Boundary commits are now skipped and the id/body date stands in. (2) GATE-SKIP-1: foundation/fleet.py merge_lane read the combined /status (no Actions check-runs, so pending/0) and merged PRs whose checks run was skipped; it now mirrors seed/worker/src/greenguard.js on check-runs and needs checks=success. (3) SCHEMA-HEAL-1: a tick step that throws no such table/column re-runs migrate and retries once before filing TICKFAIL.
